description: The bar chart titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment" compares the runtime in seconds of different models in a streaming environment. The vertical axis represents the runtime in seconds, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400. The horizontal axis lists the names of the models: Our Joint Framework, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLLaMA, and Claude. Each model is represented by a bar, with Our Joint Framework shown in green and the others in sky blue. The runtime values are annotated above each bar. Our Joint Framework has the shortest runtime at 77 seconds, followed by LLLaMA at 172 seconds, ChatGPT at 190 seconds, Claude at 243 seconds, and DeepSeek with the longest runtime at 365 seconds. The chart does not include any additional visual emphasis such as shading or bolding of bars.
